description: This source file defines a class 'MenuContextCardInjector' that manages the injection of a custom context menu card into an NSMenu in a macOS app. It handles cache loading, menu delegate methods, and view injection using SwiftUI and AppKit.

classes.name: MenuContextCardInjector
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for injecting a custom context card into a macOS menu, managing cache data, and handling menu events.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up the injector into an NSStatusItem, wrapping the menu delegate to insert custom menu items.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Handles the event when the menu is about to open, injecting the custom SwiftUI view as a menu item.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Cleans up when the menu closes, cancelling ongoing tasks.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Pass-through for menu update events to the original delegate.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Provides a confinement rectangle for the menu's screen positioning.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Asynchronous method to load or refresh cached session data, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: cachedView
methods.description: Generates a SwiftUI AnyView representing the current cache state.

methods.name: loadCurrentRows
methods.description: Loads session rows asynchronously, filtering and sorting them based on timestamps.

methods.name: findInsertIndex
methods.description: Determines the index in the menu where the custom view should be inserted, prioritizing positions after separators.

methods.name: initialCardWidth
methods.description: Calculates the initial width for the injected card based on menu and previous state.

methods.name: captureMenuWidthIfAvailable
methods.description: Attempts to determine the width of the menu hosting view to optimize layout.
